C9000308.statement: Campaign audit of both staged Smith--Toda manuscripts. Main existence theorems remain open until their dependencies and independent review are complete.

C_SCOPE_308.statement: Angeltveit arXiv:2610.23215v1 Theorem 1.1 supplies independent V(4) existence for p>=11, not verification of either staged proof or arbitrary-height existence.

C_MAIN_VARYING.statement: Varying-primes thm:main: for every fixed n>=0, some prime admits a finite first-power V(n) with its canonical BP comodule and degree-zero generator.

C_VAR_FOUNDATIONS.statement: found:ultraproduct, found:rectification, found:finite-cell-morita and found:koszul-realization provide rational graded models, finite cell tensor comparison, specified nulls and cofiber realization.

C_VAR_POWER.statement: power:exactness and power:operation: a single Euler map kills the whole comparison object, giving an exact unnormalized permutation power after inversion.

C_VAR_LAYER.statement: layer:comparison: the multiplicative Euler quotient and arbitrary-coefficient comparison retain the specified null, scalar action and moving degree.

C_VAR_MODELS.statement: universal:triangular, universal:filtered-cells, universal:primewise-models: compatible filtered primewise coefficient algebras and finite-cell modules exist.

C_VAR_WHOLE_MODULE.statement: universal:whole-module: on one large prime set, the entire associated graded module is the tensor of the indicated multiplication cofibers, not merely a fixed-weight comparison.

C_UC_STABLE.statement: conn:stable-elements: for odd p and k<p^2, restriction with trivial or sign coefficients identifies symmetric-group cohomology with the signed normalizer invariants of its elementary abelian Sylow subgroup.

C_UC_SPLIT.statement: Over any commutative ring, the Koszul-invariant tensor power of an even-unit split graded module decomposes by occupied slots; last-slot augmentation is identity on lower occupations and zero on full occupation, with no normalization factor.

C_UC_SPLIT_FORMAL.statement: Lean 4.31.0 establishes the universal finite-support free-alphabet Koszul invariant splitting, coefficient-one augmentation section, and full-occupation kernel equivalence. Tensor-basis fidelity and independent review remain separate.

C_UC_SIGNS.statement: The independent multiplier characters and block signs give the stated trivial and sign-isotypical tensor models, including Koszul signs and unused-letter vanishing.

C_UC_TOPOLOGY.statement: Bounded-below virtual Thom spectra have the specified rank-shifted group-cohomology model, degreewise finite homology, and first-nonzero stable Hurewicz detection; the map is block inclusion, not transfer.

C_UC_SYMMETRIC.statement: conn:symmetric holds uniformly for all positive C, odd primes p>C, k<=Cp, and integer virtual sphere degrees d, for the specified multiplication map.

C_UC_ESTIMATE.statement: conn:estimate: the whole-module model and positive-mass finite filtration imply the displayed bound at p lambda+delta for every fixed stage and fixed lattice indices, uniformly in multiplicities.

C_UC_SHARP.statement: For odd p, 0<k=lp<p^2 and every even integer d, the specified multiplication cofiber has exact first nonzero degree kd+2l(p-1)-1. For odd d and b=0,1, the extended power has exact first degree kd+l(p-2); b>=2 gives zero.

C_UC_WEIGHT_IMPLICATION.statement: For every model satisfying eq:whole-module and the specified bounded positive-mass filtration, conn:symmetric implies conn:estimate at every fixed stage and fixed lattice indices, uniformly over all growing multiplicities; this is a conditional implication, not existence of that model.

C_UC_CONDITIONAL.statement: The parameter-uniform signed invariant/restriction theorem proves conn:symmetric and the conditional implication from the exact whole-module model to conn:estimate; it does not establish that model.

C_VAR_KTEST.statement: conn:degree-gap and conn:k-test: the fixed-index strict degree gap and finite-module pairing give the Koszul-module test, using arbitrary-object layer comparison.

C_VAR_NORMALIZATION.statement: norm:amitsur, norm:target-locality, norm:normalization, norm:naturality and norm:attachment produce norm:construction and its recovery compatibilities.

C_VAR_COBORDISM.statement: cob:regularity and cob:coefficient-relation identify the leading Euler coefficient with the next p-series coefficient modulo predecessors and compare the resulting ideals with Hazewinkel ideals.

C_VAR_REALIZATION.statement: real:hurewicz and real:finite-descent: normalized attachments have the required Hurewicz images, descend as one finite diagram, and yield the first-power BP quotient and its canonical comodule.

C_MAIN_FIXED.statement: Prime-1009 companion main theorem: a finite p-local V(4) has BP homology BP_*/(p,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4) with canonical quotient comodule.

C_FIXED_FRAMEWORK.statement: BP coordinates, v_5 coboundary, normalized cobar bounds, range comparison, strongly convergent ordinary ANSS and binary-map Leibniz pairing.

C_FIXED_LOWER.statement: low:algebraic-vanishing, low:finite-localization, low:V3 construct finite unital V(3) at p=1009 and its binary multiplication.

C_FIXED_TARGETS.statement: may:target-bound leaves only k=1,2,p-1,p as possible v_4 differential indices; may:first-differential kills k=1 using the v_5 relation.

C_FIXED_FROBENIUS.statement: Frobenius exact sequence, quotient action, LHS spectral sequence and finite coefficient filtration eliminate k=2,p-1.

C_FIXED_FINAL.statement: Small-stem bounds and the extended-power null composite yield the beta-power relation and eliminate k=p before the possible v_4 differential page.

C_FIXED_REALIZATION.statement: Permanent v_4 lifts by the ANSS edge; the unital binary product extends it to a self-map, and regularity plus the bottom map identifies the finite cofiber's BP comodule.
